topic: Wado Ichimonji, the sword that helped hurt Sommers, was Kuina's
title: The Sword That Hurt Sommers Belonged To Kuina
description: One of the three swords Zoro coated in Supreme King Haki in chapter 1194 is Wado Ichimonji, which belonged to Kuina before it was his. Here is why that matters. Which of his swords hits hardest?
comment: Does Zoro's strength come from Mihawk's lesson or from Kuina's promise? Pick one.

lines.text: The sword that hurt a Knight of God belonged to a dead girl.

shot.fallback: green haired swordsman holding a white hilted sword in his teeth

lines.text: In chapter 1194, Zoro coats all three of his swords in Supreme King Haki.

shot.fallback: swordsman with three black coated blades

lines.text: Everyone talks about Enma, the demon sword.

shot.fallback: swordsman with a dark demon sword

lines.text: But look at the one in his mouth. That's Wado Ichimonji.

shot.fallback: swordsman biting a white hilted sword

lines.text: It belonged to Kuina, his childhood friend and the daughter of the dojo master, Koshiro.

shot.fallback: young girl with a wooden sword in a dojo

lines.text: When she died, her father gave Zoro her sword.

shot.fallback: boy holding a girl's sword at a grave

lines.text: They'd sworn that one of them would become the world's greatest swordsman.

shot.fallback: two children with swords at sunset

lines.text: Zoro carries that vow into every fight, including the one he lost at the Baratie.
Other swords of his have broken or been replaced. Wado never has.
People say it's just a sword. I think it's the one he's fighting for.

shot.fallback: swordsman fighting with a white hilted sword

lines.text: So the cut Elbaph needed carried a promise from a dead girl.

shot.search: Zoro Sommers Supreme King Haki cut
shot.fallback: glowing slash across an armored knight

lines.text: Because the sword that hurt a Knight of God...

shot.fallback: green haired swordsman holding a white hilted sword in his teeth
